free_tier.stated: "Quantum Computing for everybody - Quick and free registration - Access to our hardware backends - Project storage - Hybrid classical-quantum computing." The hardware is described as "Currently, these are Tuna-5, Tuna-9 and Tuna-17. Tuna-5 has 5 transmons [...] Tuna-9 has 9 transmons [...] Tuna-17 has 17 transmons", alongside a 26-qubit QX emulator and a Rydberg neutral-atom emulator from TU Eindhoven. No card is asked for and no expiry is published.
